issues.explanation: The limitations note asserts that شکل ۱ prints «صحت عملکردی» (as opposed to «صحت کارکردی» in the body clauses). The only cited figure evidence for شکل ۱ is F23684-شکل ۱, whose ROWS data is truncated at PQ.3 (امنیت) and never reaches the functional-correctness sub-characteristic row. The parenthetical in F23684-شکل ۱ ('یک مورد (صحت کارکردی) با m') uses the transcriber's identifier, not a verbatim figure caption. No cited evidence item confirms that the figure cell itself prints «صحت عملکردی». The fact is stated in the project's binding terminology rules but is not a cited evidence item.
issues.quote: شکل ۱ «صحت عملکردی» و بندها «صحت کارکردی» چاپ کرده‌اند
issues.suggested_fix: Add a parenthetical marking the source of this observation: «(این تفاوت بر اساس سوابق مستند پروژه ثبت شده است؛ ردیف مربوط در شکل ۱ در مدرک شاهد ارائه‌شده قطع می‌شود)». Alternatively, supply a supplementary evidence item covering that specific figure row.

issues.explanation: The limitations note states that clause 5.6 does not use the word «جدید» in its body text — contrasting with the 'a' marker in the figures. No cited evidence item for clause 5.6 (S23684-043 through S23684-050) contains or denies the word «جدید» in the body text of that clause; S23684-043 only confirms the marker appears in the two شکل figures, not what clause 5.6's body says. This is an absence claim about unprovided text.
issues.quote: شفافیت در هر دو شکل علامت a دارد اما بند ۵.۶ واژهٔ «جدید» را نمی‌آورد
